name: The Muse
tagline: Job and company culture API for career discovery and employer branding.
description: The Muse API provides access to job listings, company profiles, and workplace culture data for career discovery applications. It enables developers to search jobs by location, level, and category, and to retrieve employer branding content including company descriptions and office locations.

auth.details: API key via api_key query parameter; free self-serve registration on developer portal

pricing.free_tier_limits: 500 requests per hour without an API key; 3,600 requests per hour with a registered app's API key.

rate_limits: 500 requests per hour without an API key; 3,600 requests per hour with an API key. Responses include X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Limit, and X-RateLimit-Reset headers.
use_cases: search job listings by location and category
fetch company culture and employer branding profiles
list jobs for a specific company
filter open roles by experience level
